cards.ex: I tend to lose focus when I'm working on a boring task.
cards.exUz: Men zerikarli vazifani bajarayotganimda diqqatimni yo'qotaman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir narsaga jamlay olmaslik, chalg'ish.

cards.ex: You need to pay attention in class if you want to understand the material.
cards.exUz: Agar materialni tushunmoqchi bo'lsangiz, darsda diqqat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: E'tibor bilan tinglash yoki kuzatish.

cards.ex: I got sidetracked by a funny video and forgot what I was doing.
cards.exUz: Men kulgili video bilan chalg'ib ketdim va nima qilayotganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzudan yoki vazifadan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: Sometimes I just zone out during long meetings.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan men uzoq yig'ilishlar paytida shunchaki ongdan o'chib qolaman.
cards.uzDef: Atrofdagilarga e'tibor bermaslik, xayolga berilish.

cards.ex: Keep your eye on the road while you're driving!
cards.exUz: Haydash paytida yo'lga ko'zingizni olmang!
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan kuzatish, e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: My attention span is pretty short these days.
cards.exUz: Mening diqqat davomiyligim hozir juda qisqa.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni uzoq vaqt davomida saqlab turish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He's easily distracted by noises in the office.
cards.exUz: U ofisdagi shovqinlar bilan osongina chalg'iydi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan diqqatni yo'qotuvchi, chalg'uvchan.

cards.ex: The bright colors really get your attention.
cards.exUz: Yorqin ranglar chindan ham diqqatni jalb qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir e'tibor berishni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: I've got a mental block about writing this essay.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu inshoni yozishda ongiy to'siqqa duch keldim.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vazifani bajarishda qiyinchilik sezish.

cards.ex: The students were off task and chatting amongst themselves.
cards.exUz: Talabalar vazifadan chetda edi va o'zaro suhbatlashishardi.
cards.uzDef: Berilgan vazifani bajarmaslik, boshqa narsa bilan shug'ullanish.

cards.ex: He seemed preoccupied with something; he wasn't listening.
cards.exUz: U nimadir bilan banddek tuyuldi; u eshitmadi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida ko'p o'ylash, fikrlash bilan band bo'lish.

cards.ex: She was inattentive to the speaker's remarks.
cards.exUz: U ma'ruzachining so'zlariga e'tiborsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat qilmaslik, e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: Kids these days have such a short attention span.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda bolalarning diqqati juda qisqa.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni qisqa vaqt ushlab turish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: I had to snap myself out of it and get back to work.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni o'zimga keltirishim va ishga qaytishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xayoldan yoki yomon kayfiyatdan tezda chiqish.

cards.ex: He had tunnel vision and couldn't see the bigger picture.
cards.exUz: U tunnel ko'rishiga ega edi va katta rasmni ko'ra olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bir narsaga e'tibor qaratish, boshqa narsalarni inkor qilish.

cards.ex: I easily lose track of time when I'm reading a good book.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi kitob o'qiyotganimda vaqtni osonlikcha yo'qotaman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt, joy yoki esda tutish zarur bo'lgan narsalarni oson yo'qotish.

cards.ex: My mind started wandering during the lecture.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruza paytida mening xayollarim boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar bir mavzudan boshqasiga tasodifiy tarzda o'tishi.

cards.ex: His lack of focus is affecting his grades.
cards.exUz: Uning diqqat yetishmasligi baholariga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir nuqtaga jamlay olmaslik holati.

cards.ex: I'm not very good at multitasking.
cards.exUz: Men ko'p vazifalilikda juda yaxshi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta vazifani bajarish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a word in edgewise when she's talking.
cards.exUz: U gapirayotganda gapga qo'shilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar gapirayotganda so'zlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish (ko'pincha qiyin).

cards.ex: I'm so scatterbrained today; I keep forgetting things.
cards.exUz: Men bugun juda tarqoq fikrliman; men narsalarni unutib qo'yaman.
cards.uzDef: Eslab qolishda yoki diqqatni jamlashda qiyinchiliklarga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He's completely obsessed with video games.
cards.exUz: U video o'yinlariga butunlay mukkasidan ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga haddan tashqari qiziqish bildirish.

cards.ex: She gets easily bored if there's nothing to do.
cards.exUz: Agar qilinadigan hech narsa bo'lmasa, u osongina zerikadi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda zerikadigan, qiziqishini yo'qotadigan.

cards.ex: You need to focus your energy on finishing this project.
cards.exUz: Siz ushbu loyihani tugatishga kuchingizni jamlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish, vazifani bajarish uchun kuchingizni yo'naltirish.

cards.ex: A wandering mind can be creative, but also unproductive.
cards.exUz: Xayolparast ong ijodiy, lekin samarasiz ham bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Doimo bir fikrdan ikkinchisiga sakraydigan ong.

cards.ex: I need to get my head down and finish this report.
cards.exUz: Men boshimni egib, ushbu hisobotni tugatishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni jiddiy bajarishga kirishish.

cards.ex: I completely lost the thread of what he was saying.
cards.exUz: Men uning nima deyayotganini butunlay unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Hikoya yoki argumentning mazmunini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I'm easily distracted by my phone when I'm trying to work.
cards.exUz: Men ishlamoqchi bo'lganimda telefonim bilan osongina chalg'iyman.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan diqqatni boshqa narsaga o'tkazadi.

cards.ex: When I'm in the zone, I can write for hours.
cards.exUz: Men ish jarayonida bo'lganimda, soatlab yozishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: To'liq diqqat va e'tibor bilan ishlayotgan holat.

cards.ex: You need to pay close attention to the instructions.
cards.exUz: Siz ko'rsatmalarga diqqat bilan e'tibor berishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda diqqatli bo'lish, har bir detalga e'tibor qaratish.
